text:
maria: quick idea - unify console + cli for recomputes with a selector API that does quota checks, dry-run preview, and cost estimates. want feedback.
ajay: big question: API should reject oversize requests or return a recommended stagger plan?
kevin: prefer fail-fast with helpful payload (est_tokens, est_gpu_hours). saves ops from backlogged jobs.
liz: UX wants a preview modal showing sampled rows + diff histogram and a "sample" toggle for QA.
maria: proto payload I mocked (short): POST /v1/recompute/select { selector: 'env:prod AND metric:agg_hours AND dt>=2026-03-01', canary_pct:10, quota_mode:'check-only', dry_run:true, preview_size:250 }
carmen: tenancy: reserved-capacity tenants need a "reserve" mode that doesn't touch shared pool. API must return clear error when reservation > commit.
ajay: default quota_mode=check-only. API should also return recommended_stagger windows when estimate > quota.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: recompute-select-v1 -> staging 2026-03-12T18:00Z :package:
kevin: routing_hint field so console can show Dedicated vs Hosted cost/latency. include preview_hash for reproducible sampling.
liz: mark preview rows with which clause matched and a sample hash. show a "risk" badge if sample diff > 8%.
maria: response should include plan_id and cost_breakdown (estimate_tokens, estimate_gpu_hours, downstream_reads). all strings.
kevin: if quota exceeded and quota_mode=="consume", return 409 with suggestions array of windows and an apply_recommendation link.
ops-bot: scheduler supports slot reservations & preemption. will add an endpoint to convert suggestions into reservations.
carmen: audit log every selector.create and selector.execute with plan_id, user, quota_mode, estimate.
ajay: i'll drive the API contract PR with these fields: quota_mode, canary_pct, preview_size, preview_hash, estimated_tokens, estimated_gpu_hours, routing_hint, plan_id, suggestions.
maria: sync tomorrow 10am to finalize console mocks + contract. ping me with additions. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: canary rollout started for recompute-select-v1 -> canary-1 :rocket:
